newsitem.title: USA: Maine driver charged with killing ducks.
newsitem.headline: Maine driver charged with killing ducks.

text.p: A Maine driver has been charged after witnesses said he ran his car through a flock of ducks in a supermarket parking lot, police said.
Five ducks were killed Sunday when Daniel Whitney allegedly drove his car into the flock, which often gathers in the parking lot waiting for handouts from shoppers, the police said.
Bystanders said Whitney, 20, and three juvenile passengers laughed as the car ran over the ducks, according to the police.
Whitney was arrested after he stopped at a nearby store.
"I didn't intentionally try to hit the ducks," Whitney, of Auburn, was quoted by the Lewiston Sun Journal as saying, adding that he regretted the birds were killed.
Whitney received a summons for "illegal use of a migratory bird" and is scheduled to appear in court in April. If convicted, He could be sentenced to a year in prison and a fine.
